in_sanskrit.name: Anjanaish
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord or master of beauty or adornment
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over beauty or adornment

in_hindi.name: अञ्जनीश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who removes darkness (of ignorance), Lord of darkness, developer of darkness, worshipper of beautiful leaves

in_tamil.name: அஞ்சணிஷ
in_tamil.meaning: கலைமான, கலைக்கோவிழ், கலைவி, விஷயம் குறிப்பிட்ட இடம்

in_telugu.name: అఞ్జనీశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is superior, the one who is the master, the one who is the lord, the one who is the ruler of a place

in_marathi.name: Anjanish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Anjani's Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anjanish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word Anjana, meaning 'Goddess Anjani'. Anjanish is a name of great joy and delight, evoking images of the divine mother's love and nurturing care.
